notes: This directory is the authoritative staged golden ISA definition for v0.56.5.
v0.56.5 is the live canonical LinxISA profile for this repository.
v0.56.5 retains the expanded 16-entry-per-hand tile register file, dynamic tile capacity descriptors, and the canonical B.IOR/B.IOT/B.CATR/B.DATR block descriptor spellings.
B.IOD is a reserved encoding. BSTART.PAR is a retired spelling whose former bit pattern decodes only as BSTART.TEPL.
Historical pre-v0.56 profile material is removed from active repository surfaces after this profile validates.
